#939 · EleFrog Pokémon

Bellibolt

Electric

Paldea · Generation 9

Bellibolt is an Electric-type EleFrog Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 113 kg. It evolves from Tadbulb. Its highest base stat is HP (109), with a base stat total of 495.
